title: Every tap is recorded with no way to say no; Quebec and federal privacy guidance want a choice for collection the service does not need
evidence: app/public/js/track.js:1-9 records 'app opens, screens, every tap, visibility, errors' ('build everything for collecting EVERYTHING'); listing.md:77 'Not gated by any consent'; privacy.html lists it with no opt-out. OPC meaningful-consent guideline: 'a clear and easily accessible choice for any collection, use or disclosure that is not necessary' https://www.priv.gc.ca/en/privacy-topics/collecting-personal-information/consent/gl_omc_201805/ . Quebec P-39.1 s.12 limits use to the collection purpose unless consistent, or de-identified for statistics; s.90.1(2) makes collection 'in contravention of the law' an AMP item; s.90.12 cap $50,000 for a natural person; s.14 says a written consent request 'must be presented separately from any other information', so the single 'I agree to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy' tick cannot be the basis for optional uses; s.9.1 says privacy settings must default to 'the highest level of confidentiality by default'. https://www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca/en/document/cs/P-39.1
fix: Cheapest: keep the events that run the service and the funnel (opens, screens, errors, purchase steps) and drop per-tap detail, or de-identify events before analysis. A toggle also works but, under s.9.1, it must start off, which loses most of the data.

title: Quebec requires the privacy procedures to be described on the website; they are written but the policy page does not describe them
evidence: docs/privacy/data-requests.md and breach-plan.md exist (commit ebcb033). grep 'governance|complaint' docs/store/privacy*.html: no hits. P-39.1 s.3.2: 'Detailed information about those policies and practices ... must be published in simple and clear language on the enterprise's website' https://www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca/en/document/cs/P-39.1 . s.3.2 is not in the s.90.1 penalty list, so the cost is a CAI compliance order after a complaint, not a fine.
fix: Add one short section to privacy.html and privacy-fr.html: how requests and complaints are handled, the response time, and that incidents are recorded.

title: A Quebec shopper sees Pexi entirely in English, including the Terms they tick, the paywall and the store page

Charter of the French language s.52.1 software 'must be available in French unless no French version exists' (one exists); s.55 a contract of adhesion in another language binds only after the French version was given and the party expressly chose otherwise; enforcement is an OQLF order (s.177) and disobeying it is an offence, $700 to $7,000 for a natural person (s.205), doubled then tripled on repeat (s.207). https://www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca/en/document/cs/C-11

title: No written agreement between Jamin and Aurik on code ownership, the name, or money; without one Aurik owns the copyright in his own code

HANDOVER.md:117 'nothing is on file'. git shortlog -sne --all: 627 commits xu826Jamin, 426 Aurik Disler. Copyright Act s.13(1) 'the author of a work shall be the first owner'; s.13(4) no assignment is valid 'unless it is in writing signed by the owner' https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/c-42/section-13.html . Ontario Partnerships Act: sharing profits is prima facie evidence of a partnership, which makes each partner liable for the firm's debts https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/90p05 (official page did not render; wording from a search summary, secondary). No LICENSE file in the repo.

title: App income is self-employment business income: income tax plus both halves of CPP, filed on a T2125
evidence: CRA encourages Form T2125 for business income; gross business income goes to line 13499 https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/sole-proprietorships-partnerships/report-business-income-expenses.html (and the T2125 page via search). Self-employed people 'pay both the employer and employee contribution'; 2026 rate 5.95% each, self-employed maximum $8,460.90 https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/payroll-deductions-contributions/canada-pension-plan-cpp/cpp-contribution-rates-maximums-exemptions.html . Self-employed filing deadline June 15, payment due April 30 https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/topics/important-dates-individuals.html . Business costs (Apple fee, Cloudflare, Anthropic, domain) are deductible against it. If Aurik takes a share, the partnership finding changes who reports what. GST is in legal review q24-25.
fix: Set aside roughly a quarter of net profit for tax and CPP (assumed rate, depends on his other income); have an accountant do the first return.
fix_cost: accountant fee for one return (not sourced)

title: Records and payouts: keep six years of records; Apple pays within 45 days of each fiscal month to one bank account
evidence: CRA: keep records 'six years from the end of the last tax year they relate to' https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/keeping-records/where-keep-your-records-long-request-permission-destroy-them-early.html . Apple: payments 'within 45 days of the last day of the fiscal month', only above the minimum payment threshold, 'Payments to multiple or split bank accounts aren't supported', and a Paid Apps Agreement must be in effect https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/getting-paid/overview-of-receiving-payments . HANDOVER.md lists 'the bills table' as unfilled.
fix: Download Apple's monthly financial reports and every bill into one folder each month; a separate bank account for the Apple deposits makes this automatic. Any split with Aurik is paid out by Jamin, since Apple pays one account.
